main_issue: Who gets leave on the working day before/after Hari Raya (especially the first day), given only two staff can be off... actually two must be on duty, so only two can be off; C volunteers to work, and D finally gives up the first day.

A-B.evidence: A and B both claim the first day (T11-T14, T18-T20); B says 'not simple isn't impossible'; ends with D yielding, so conflict is resolved without either of them conceding.

A-C.evidence: C offers to work Hari Raya days (T7), which leaves A's leave compatible; A never addresses C directly, and the outcome (T22-T23) suits both.

A-D.evidence: A competed with D for the first day (T11, T16-T17); D yields (T22), A replies 'Thanks, Agent D. That works then' (T23).

B-C.evidence: C offers to work Hari Raya days (T7), which lets B take the first day; they never address each other directly.

B-D.evidence: D competes for the first day (T16), then says 'you should take the day. I'll work with Agent C' (T22); B thanks D (T26).

C-D.evidence: C: 'I'll do Hari Raya, you do Christmas' (T9), D agrees (T10); D ends up working the first day with C (T22), consistent with the plan.
